crossRefs.note: The great court around had three courses of cut stone, and a course of cedar beams; like the inner court of Yahweh’s…
He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

translations.web: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
translations.bsb: Then He brought me to the entrance to the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.
translations.kjv: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
translations.asv: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
